citations.quote: The EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) is the world's first comprehensive AI law. It applies in tiers: prohibited practices from February 2025, GPAI rules from August 2025, and high-risk AI obligations from December 2027 (Annex III) and August 2028 (Annex I) after the 2026 omnibus amendments.
